integrity: Qualitative negative-entry behavior already noted in the literature is explicitly excluded from the novelty claim. The new claim is supported by an exact residual-minimization derivation, a nondegenerate limiting recurrence, a continuity argument, and an independently replayed rational witness.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns depth-one, unit-mixing Anderson acceleration and proves an open small-parameter two-dimensional diagonal family. It does not give a sharp contraction-factor threshold, does not classify larger memory, and does not cover safeguarded or constrained variants.
source_ids: Copper Mountain Conference abstract: Homer F. Walker, Anderson Acceleration for Fixed-Point Iterations (2010-03-02)
title: Depth-one Anderson acceleration can break a positive diagonal contraction in two dimensions
